find: for (let i = active.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) recycle(active[i], i);
why: Issue #232 asks for cleanup on round reset and arena change, which reach the renderer as issue #531's worldReplaced announcement. A wreck that survives it is drawn at the OLD board's coordinates on the new one -- the defect that announcement exists to prevent, where an inferred discontinuity turned two tread decals into 158 -- and six seconds of lifetime is long enough for a cleared level to straddle. Every other behaviour is untouched, so only a test that replaces the world sees it.
killedBy: housekeeping clear retires every wreck, so a new board does not inherit the old one's dead
